title: Distribution of values of higher derivatives of $L'(s,χ)/L(s,χ)$
summary: In this article, we study the value distribution theory for the first derivative of the logarithmic derivative of Dirichlet $L$-functions, generalizing certain results of Ihara, Matsumoto et al. related to ``$M$-functions'' for $σ= \operatorname{Re}(s) > 1$. We then discuss the main obstruction toward generalization to higher derivatives.
